batter_post_dot.metric_name: Post-Dot Drought State Scoring Recovery (Preceded by >= 2 Dots)
batter_post_dot.trigger_definition: Sequence where an individual batter reaches k >= 2 consecutive personal dot balls in an innings
batter_post_dot.observation_window: All deliveries faced while remaining in the drought state (streak >= 2) until broken by a scoring shot
batter_post_dot.unit_of_observation: Batter delivery faced under drought state (striker_id, match_id, delivery_id)
batter_post_dot.numerator_definition: Sum of off-bat runs scored across all drought-state deliveries
batter_post_dot.denominator_definition: Total legal deliveries faced while in the drought state (streak >= 2)
batter_post_dot.reconciliation_explanation: Subsequent observations (19,818) exceed trigger sequences (14,876) because the metric evaluates every delivery faced while the batter is in a drought state (streak >= 2). When a drought streak compounds to 3, 4, or 5 consecutive dots, each additional dot faced is evaluated under the drought state, generating multiple observations per trigger (mean 1.33 balls per trigger sequence). If strictly restricted to a single subsequent delivery at t+1 per trigger sequence, there are exactly 12,653 deliveries faced (the remaining 2,223 triggers were truncated by the end of the innings or dismissal).
batter_post_dot.handling_of_boundaries: Dot streaks strictly reset at innings boundary or match conclusion. Deliveries spanning innings boundaries are impossible because grouping is partitioned by (match_id, innings, striker_id). Incomplete streaks (< 2 dots) produce zero triggers.
batter_post_dot.zero_leakage_status: VERIFIED: Trigger evaluates only preceding delivery outcomes (runs == 0). Outcomes are evaluated strictly forward in time.

batter_post_wicket.trigger_definition: Team wicket event (is_wicket == True) occurring in the match innings
batter_post_wicket.observation_window: First 6 legal deliveries of the innings following the wicket event
batter_post_wicket.unit_of_observation: Delivery faced by striker in window (striker_id, match_id, delivery_id)
batter_post_wicket.numerator_definition: Sum of off-bat runs scored in post-wicket window
batter_post_wicket.denominator_definition: Total legal deliveries faced in post-wicket window
batter_post_wicket.handling_of_boundaries: Windows do not cross innings boundaries. Deliveries in 20th over stop at end of innings (window truncated naturally without distortion).
batter_post_wicket.zero_leakage_status: VERIFIED: Trigger event occurs prior to window deliveries.

bowler_post_boundary.trigger_definition: Delivery where runs off the bat in (4, 6) conceded by the bowler
bowler_post_boundary.observation_window: The immediate next legal delivery (t+1) bowled by the SAME bowler in the SAME over
bowler_post_boundary.numerator_definition: Total runs conceded by bowler on (t+1) delivery (including wides/no-balls charged)
bowler_post_boundary.handling_of_boundaries: Deliveries on the 6th ball of an over CANNOT have a (t+1) delivery in the same over; they are strictly excluded from the intra-over bounce-back denominator to prevent confounding cross-over spell breaks.
bowler_post_boundary.zero_leakage_status: VERIFIED: Trigger delivery strictly precedes (t+1) delivery in match timeline.

bowler_post_cluster.trigger_definition: Bowler conceding >= 8 runs across a rolling 3-ball window in the same innings
bowler_post_cluster.observation_window: The delivery immediately following the 3-ball cluster
bowler_post_cluster.denominator_definition: Total legal deliveries observed after cluster
bowler_post_cluster.handling_of_boundaries: Rolling clusters strictly partition by (match_id, innings, bowler_id). Cannot cross match innings.
bowler_post_cluster.zero_leakage_status: VERIFIED: Rolling window evaluates backward 3 deliveries only.

bowler_inning_over_progression.trigger_definition: Bowler's personal delivery count in match: Early Phase (Deliveries 1-12) vs Late Phase (Deliveries 13-24+)
bowler_inning_over_progression.observation_window: Deliveries within the bowler's cumulative count for that match innings
bowler_inning_over_progression.numerator_definition: Total runs conceded in each cumulative phase
bowler_inning_over_progression.denominator_definition: Total legal balls bowled in each cumulative phase
bowler_inning_over_progression.terminology_clarification: Renamed from 'Spell Progression/Fatigue' to 'Cumulative Inning Over Exposure Progression'. T20 bowlers typically bowl partitioned spells (e.g., 2 overs in Powerplay, 2 overs at Death) rather than continuous 4-over spells. This metric captures early-match vs late-match allocation performance, controlling for match inning context.
